answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluates its RLN epoch polynomial to derive a nullifier and proof for each message. The verifier permits one message per identity and scope; a duplicate reuses the nullifier, allowing two Shamir shares to be combined to recover the identity secret. A verifier can then trigger immediate slashing of the bond. The prism, crystal, and hollow names are illustrative only, not protocol components.
